objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled content subject to creation, editing, approval, release, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name or heading of the document

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current workflow state of the document such as editing, review, or released

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date when the document becomes valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date when the document validity expires

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The duration for which a document remains valid before requiring a validity check

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The type abbreviation used to identify document categories

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document file linked to a main document that is subject to the same release cycle and versioning as the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current workflow state of the attachment

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The publication status of the additional information

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggested modification to an existing document that can be created and managed independently without affecting the document version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the change proposal

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person interacting with the document management system in various roles and capacities.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The assigned function or responsibility of the user such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Reader

attributes.name: authorization
attributes.description: The permission level assigned to a user for reading or modifying documents

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users organized for assigning authorizations and distribution purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The identifier or label for the user group

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: The category of access rights such as Reader, Archive, or Document Management

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A workflow-supported request created when a document approaches the end of its validity period to decide whether to extend validity, revise, or invalidate the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the validity extension request process

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the override request process

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the reactivation request process

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A record of user groups or persons designated to receive notifications or acknowledgement requests upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: The method of distribution such as by email or for acknowledgement

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic confirmation of authorization and responsibility by a workflow participant on a document.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: The user who applied the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the signature was applied

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A process-controlled sequence of steps for document approval, release, translation, or validity management.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: The current stage in the workflow progression such as Creator, Review, or Release

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: The user responsible for executing the workflow step

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user interface providing role-specific views and lists of relevant documents and tasks.

attributes.name: user_role
attributes.description: The type of user accessing the dashboard such as Reader or Author

objs.name: report
objs.description: A formal evaluation or analysis output providing filtered information about documents based on selected parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The category of report such as Status Report or Search Report

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: The criteria used to filter and shape the report results

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document that requires approval and release workflow.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The target language of the translation

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current workflow state of the translated document

objs.name: client
objs.description: An organizational entity or system instance in a multi-client environment that determines visibility and access scope for documents.

attributes.name: visibility
attributes.description: Whether a document is visible or not in the client

objs.name: reference
objs.description: A link or connection from one document to another document or to other master data.

attributes.name: target_object
attributes.description: The document or master data object being referenced

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: An active confirmation by a user that they have received and reviewed a document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is pending

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the acknowledgement was confirmed

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the substantive content of a document using an editing client based on the source format.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Set or update document properties and attributes including master data, control settings, and authorization assignments.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Define and grant read or write permissions for a document to specific users or user groups by role.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically transform the edited document from its source format to PDF representation for web display.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to readers through automatic publication after approval.

evts.name: submit_document_for_review
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported three-step release process consisting of Creator, Review, and Release steps.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Examine document content and properties according to technical and formal aspects as part of the release workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and finalize a document for distribution by signing and confirming its readiness in the final approval step.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply an electronic signature to a document as evidence of authorization and responsibility during workflow steps.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Generate a new version of a document when changes to content, attributes, or attachments are made after release.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm that a document remains valid for an additional period when approaching the validity expiration date.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document invalid and archive it by revoking authorizations when the document no longer has validity.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document by creating a new version with restored properties.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a suggested modification to an existing document without affecting the document version or content.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Plan and apply an accepted change proposal to create a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled document file that is subject to the release cycle and versioning of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as archived when it is no longer relevant to the current version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Append supplementary material to a document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Remove additional information from a document directly without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document that requires separate approval and release workflow.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Send notification emails to assigned user groups and persons upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Require assigned recipients to actively confirm receipt and review of a document upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Actively acknowledge receipt and review of a distributed document through workflow-supported confirmation.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Initiate a workflow-supported request when a document reaches 30 days before validity expiration to decide on extended validity or override.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate a workflow-supported request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document during the archiving period.

evts.name: view_document
evts.description: Access and display an approved document with its content, attachments, and related information.

evts.name: view_dashboard
evts.description: Access a role-specific dashboard displaying relevant documents and workflow tasks.

o2e.description: A Document is created through the Create Document event

A Document receives authorization assignments through the Assign Authorization event
A Document is converted to PDF format in the Convert Document to PDF event
A Document is published in the Publish Document event
A Document is submitted for review workflow in the Submit Document for Review event
A User performs the Review Document event
A Document is reviewed in the Review Document event
A User performs the Release Document event
A Document is released in the Release Document event
A User applies a signature in the Sign Document event
A Document receives a signature in the Sign Document event
A new version of a Document is created in the Create New Version event
A Document validity is extended in the Extend Validity event
A Document is invalidated and archived in the Override Document event
A Document is reactivated in the Reactivate Document event
A Change Proposal is created in the Create Change Proposal event
A Change Proposal references a Document in the Create Change Proposal event
A Change Proposal is implemented in the Implement Change Proposal event
A Document receives changes through the Implement Change Proposal event
An Attachment is created in the Create Attachment event
A Document receives an Attachment in the Create Attachment event
An Attachment is archived in the Archive Attachment event
Additional Information is created in the Create Additional Information event
A Document receives Additional Information in the Create Additional Information event
Additional Information is deleted in the Delete Additional Information event
A Translation is created in the Translate Document event
A Document is translated in the Translate Document event
A User Group receives distribution in the Distribute Document by Email event
A Document is distributed through the Distribute Document by Email event
A User Group is requested to acknowledge in the Request Acknowledgement event
A Document is subject to acknowledgement requests in the Request Acknowledgement event
A User confirms acknowledgement in the Confirm Acknowledgement event
An Acknowledgement is confirmed in the Confirm Acknowledgement event
A Validity Extension Request is created in the Create Validity Extension Request event
A Document triggers the Create Validity Extension Request event
An Override Request is created in the Create Override Request event
A Document triggers the Create Override Request event
A Reactivation Request is created in the Create Reactivation Request event
A Document is subject to reactivation in the Create Reactivation Request event
A User views a Document in the View Document event
A Document is viewed in the View Document event
A User accesses a Dashboard in the View Dashboard event
A Dashboard is viewed in the View Dashboard event
